disclaimer: Toy mathematical systems for evaluating application and abstention; not exact claims about RFC TCP, real human physiology or commercial ERP behavior.

cards.title: Finite-capacity discrete queue (pedagogical abstraction)
cards.description: Starting queue q receives arrivals a and can serve up to s units during one time step, with buffer capacity b. Calculate unserved=max(0,q+a-s); next_queue=min(b,unserved); drops=max(0,unserved-b).
assumptions: All input counts are nonnegative integers
Service and arrivals apply to the same interval
must_abstain_when: An input is missing or not an integer
cards.worked_example: queue=5, arrivals=9, service=7, buffer=6: unserved=7, next_queue=6, drops=1.

cards.title: Saturated proportional regulator (pedagogical abstraction)
assumptions: Linear one-step correction is only a toy abstraction
must_abstain_when: Any input is missing or nonfinite
cards.worked_example: observed=7, setpoint=10, gain=2, limit=4, disturbance=-1: control=4 and next_state=10.

cards.title: Inventory position and reorder threshold (pedagogical abstraction)
assumptions: All counts, days and targets are nonnegative integers
A fixed deterministic lead time is assumed
must_abstain_when: Any count or day is negative
Any value is not an integer
